title: One person, three names in a SCIM user record
desc: A user record at /Users, with the three names one person has. userName is the login name: the app requires it to be unique and does not treat it as case-sensitive, and it can be edited, so it can change. externalId is a label the IdP chooses for her, and the app does not enforce that it is unique. id is assigned by the app, never changes and is never reused; the IdP stores it and uses it in later requests.
